title: One ledger gives each open PR one next act, and reports two numbers
why: Owner ask, 12:17 CST Nov 7: "How many PRs are sitting idle that haven't merged because you lost track ... mechanize this better, this is an obvious gap." Measured by the coordinator at 12:24 CST: 36 open claude-settings PRs and 16 q_max PRs are named in neither its handoff nor runner 8's queue; #1371 (git mailbox, round 3 PASS Nov 6) is one.
note:
Coordinator pick, 13:35 CST Nov 7 (undoable): the review-PASS claim check in report_guard blocks once, like the rest; it does not re-check rewrites.
Owner, page ask 13:18 CST Nov 7 (ask-mw6sd3zwp1), on step override-plain-ask: "doesn't seem like it was ever picked up mechanically then?" Right: nothing starts a ready step. At 13:25 CST, 14 now-phase steps were todo with no lane and no pause. The ledger covers ready steps too: each now-phase step with no lane gets one next act and an owner, like an open PR.
Mechanism from step pr-tracking-root-cause (record pr-ledger, accepted 12:56 CST Nov 7): one ledger in merge.py gives each open PR exactly one next act and its owner, with an age. It replaces private queues, review verdicts sent only by message, holds with no age, and the open-PR-is-progress test in stalled-steps and build.py. Done check: red on a fixture with an open PR that has no next act, or a next act older than its limit (queued with no batch after one cycle; held with no page item or debt); green when every open PR has a current act. Each coordinator and batch-runner report gives two numbers, gold 0: the longest wait from passed review to merge, and the count of open PRs with no next act. A session's report lists an on-merge PR that has waited longer than one batch cycle under Deviations, never under Next. Coordinator pick, 13:41 CST Nov 7 (undoable): part 3 splits. 3a, now: build.py gives ready and orphaned steps a next act, an owner and an age, plus the third gold-0 number. 3b, after part 1: a pure next_act() and `merge --reviewed --json` feed the PR rows. Coordinator pick, 13:53 CST Nov 7 (undoable): F2 option A. A draft with no record reads `lane round 1`, with a 72 h limit. The integration PR carries label `batch` and reads `batch run`, with a 24 h limit. Reason: normal batch and lane states show no false red, and an idle draft still goes red. Coordinator pick, 13:54 CST Nov 7 (undoable): `merge --lane-lint <pr> --integration` sets the `batch` label (option A). Reason: a mechanical label rather than a docs rule (owner, 13:28 CST). Coordinator pick, 14:40 CST, part 3a: a lane session that is completed or failed no longer counts as live in roadmap build.py, for the ready rule or the doing rule; idle and review_ready stay live. Reason: owner ruling 13:25 CST, a ready step with no working lane must show. Coordinator, 15:10 CST: the pr-ledger design time is 12:33 CST (delivery time), not the coordinator's label 12:56. Coordinator scan 21:35 CST Nov 7, unverified by a tool: (1) the ledger fix is built and idle: #1419, #1561, #1569 each have a PASS record on the live head; runner 8 puts them in batch 62 with #1347. (2) 215 PRs carry a PASS record on the live head (142 under 6 h old); 27 with no record and older than 24 h (#1315-#1386, the #1371 class); runner 8 verifies with merge --reviewed --json. (3) 26 merges in 45 h, 1-5 lanes per batch. (4) Lane cs-revive-ready compared lists and did not read PR state, so it missed #1371. (5) About 306 completed lanes unarchived, because the archive sweep was dead in the cloud until #1634; add a third gold-0 number: completed lanes not archived after one batch cycle. (6) Runner 9 classifies child-repo PRs older than 24 h (home 10, degen 6, q_max 4, banchi 3, mailaudit 2, joyous 1).
